text:
maria: Quick sync request — we need to finalize an attribution contract for inference metrics across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Current problem: cost dashboards show duplicate/unknown tenant buckets when runtime routes to fallback model variants. Can we agree on where the canonical billing_key is emitted?

sam: +1. Problem statement nailed. Two options: 1) set billing_key at front proxy (fast, cheap) 2) let runtime emit final billing_key after routing. Tradeoffs: proxy knows tenant but not final model variant, runtime knows variant but sometimes drops tenant context.

devin: runtime drops are the main cause. We sometimes route to fallback across regions and the proxy header gets lost at the GPU pool boundary. My proposal: proxy sets a tentative header `X-Billing-Hint` and runtime reconciles and emits `metric.billing_key` on every metric/event. That way metrics are accurate, proxy still has a cheap hint for quick cost estimates.

anya: agree with tentative hint + runtime final emit. Also we need to decide attribute naming and cardinality. Suggest `inference.billing_key`, `inference.model.name`, `inference.model.variant`, `inference.deployment.mode` (hosted|dedicated|private). Keep `inference.*` prefix to avoid collisions with other services.

leo: minor add: include `inference.routing.path` (e.g., primary->fallback) as low-cardinality enum so we can understand fallback frequency without exploding cardinality.

sam: mental model: proxy adds header "X-Billing-Hint: tenant:1234"; runtime will read, then after routing emit a metric line: 
```
metric:inference.latency count=1 ms=142 tags={inference.billing_key:tenant:1234, inference.model.name:llama-70b, inference.model.variant:quant-8, inference.deployment.mode:dedicated}
```
This keeps metrics self-describing.

maria: Good. A few operational constraints: 1) For Private deployments we can't rely on central proxy — so runtime MUST emit billing_key there. 2) For hosted we should still emit final billing_key to avoid blindspots. 3) If runtime doesn't have tenant mapping (edge case), fall back to `billing_hint` with tag `inference.billing_key:unknown_hint:...` so it's queryable.

devin: Also: tracing vs metrics. Traces should carry `trace.inference.billing_key` and `trace.inference.model` so span-level cost sampling can tie back to billing. But we must avoid duplicating high-cardinality baggage on every span — push canonical keys on root span only and surface low-cardinality labels on child spans.

anya: Agree. Implementation checklist:
- Proxy: set `X-Billing-Hint`.
- Runtime: read hint, resolve final key, emit metrics with `inference.billing_key` and final model tags.
- Tracing: root span has full billing_key and model, children get `trace.inference.bucket` (low-cardinality).
- Dashboard: update cost pipeline to prefer `inference.billing_key` if present, otherwise use hint.

leo: Who owns the rollout? I'd like Eng Runtime to implement the emit path, Eng Platform to update ingest docs, and Product to sanity-check dashboards.

maria: Assignments: Devin -> runtime impl (PR for header read + metric emission), Sam -> platform ingest docs + cost pipeline rule, Anya -> tracing label pattern + docs, Leo -> dashboard owner contact. ETA: PRs/Docs by EOW?

devin: I'll spike this afternoon. Quick question — do we want the runtime to emit a separate `inference.billing_resolution` metric (enum: resolved|hinted|missing) to help us measure coverage?

sam: Yes please. Very useful for rollout monitoring. Add `inference.billing_resolution` as a string tag on metrics (or a separate metric gauge).

anya: small note on retention: billing_key should be hashed in long-term retention exports to avoid PII leakage. We'll keep unhashed keys in short-term dashboards only. Add to docs.

maria: +1 on hashing for long-term. Also make sure Private deployments can opt-out of sending billing_key externally; platform will accept a `billing_key_forwarding: false` flag and use `tenant_local:<id>` labeling.

leo: ack. I'll draft the dashboard change and ping Product for cost reporting requirements.

infra-bot: deploy-checker: runtime service (canary) passed smoke tests.

maria: Nice. Next steps: Devin start PR, Sam/Anya update ingest/tracing docs, Leo coordinate dashboard, we reconvene Tue standup if more blockers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
